This index consolidates earlier scores and source identities; it does not promote chapter11 or requalify older compilers against current HEAD.

semantics.root_only: Only the physical entry-source sites are mutated. Complete imported baseline checks run; dependency mutation coverage is not inferred.
semantics.source-and-closure-bound: The retained primary proof manifest records exact current entry and literal dependency hashes.
semantics.source-bound-historical-dependencies: The primary record binds the unchanged current entry; dependency changes or missing inventory are enumerated.
semantics.log-only-identity-not-recorded: A retained passing raw score exists but does not bind source bytes. Current snapshot is only this audit observation; do not silently relabel it a compiler-owned gate receipt.
semantics.root-source-mismatch: Primary proof names a different entry hash. Its score is historical, not current-entry qualification.
semantics.compiler_epochs: Pinned executable identities remain explicit. An old executable is never claimed to match a newer source checkout. Publication/compiler-front-end gates are independent.
semantics.source-bound-post-gate-dependency-observ: Current root/compiler are bound by the original final gate JSON; a separate explicitly dated post-gate dependency observation does not masquerade as compiler-owned gate metadata.
